mapper.select: select bnd_company_id from t_cmp_binding where bnd_user_id = #{userId} and bnd_status = 1 limit 1

select svt_id as templateId, svt_name as name, svt_trigger_scene as triggerScene, svt_company_id as companyId, cast(svt_questions as char) as questions, svt_status as status from t_survey_template where svt_id = #{templateId}
mapper.insert: insert into t_survey_template (svt_name, svt_trigger_scene, svt_company_id, svt_questions, svt_status) values (#{name}, #{triggerScene}, #{companyId}, #{questions}, #{status})
mapper.update: update t_survey_template set svt_name = #{name}, svt_trigger_scene = #{triggerScene}, svt_questions = #{questions}, svt_status = #{status}, svt_updated_at = now() where svt_id = #{templateId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from t_survey_response where svr_template_id = #{templateId}
select count(*) from t_survey_dispatch where svd_template_id = #{templateId}

select t.tal_id as candidateId, t.tal_company_id as companyId, u.nick_name as candidateName from t_tal t left join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.tal_user_id where t.tal_user_id = #{userId} and t.tal_company_id = #{companyId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into t_survey_dispatch (svd_template_id, svd_candidate_id, svd_company_id, svd_sent_by, svd_link_token, svd_status) values (#{templateId}, #{candidateId}, #{companyId}, #{sentBy}, #{token}, 0)
mapper.select: select d.svd_id as dispatchId, d.svd_template_id as templateId, d.svd_candidate_id as candidateId, d.svd_status as status, cast(svt.svt_questions as char) as questions, svt.svt_name as templateName, u.nick_name as candidateName, c.cmp_name as companyName, date_format(d.svd_sent_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as sentAt from t_survey_dispatch d left join t_survey_template svt on svt.svt_id = d.svd_template_id left join t_tal t on t.tal_id = d.svd_candidate_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.tal_user_id left join t_cmp c on c.cmp_id = d.svd_company_id where d.svd_link_token = #{token}
mapper.insert: insert into t_survey_response (svr_template_id, svr_candidate_id, svr_answers, svr_satisfaction_score) values (#{templateId}, #{candidateId}, #{answers}, #{satisfactionScore})
